# P2a performance addendum: ordinary dependency merge

**PASS for merged-source static performance review**, source
`a418947fcacd49c259a83cfc7c9a7c640552117c`. No new blocking performance finding.
This carries forward the static review of
`6fb7f94173320326bd523a8af67db77916ac7da3`; it does not upgrade earlier runtime
results to a combined-source runtime pass.

Independently verified the current fixed seven-pattern path set and all 4,743
source hashes against `dependency-merge/current-source.json`, both ordinary merge
parents, the tracked index and clean status. Of the previous 4,738 source files,
4,737 are byte-identical. The only changed existing file is
`crates/android_tools/src/android_tools.rs`, with exactly one added
`pub mod parallel_sync;` after `pub mod module_presentation;`. All five new
parallel-sync source/test/license/reference files are byte-identical to protected
parent `c1ce5ca16a26fd59984b50500ead45fbafafa5c8`.

The import decoder, Gradle bridge, all 30 authored tests and retained import
references remain byte-identical to the reviewed source. Catalogue validation
still uses an ordered vector and a tree-map index, requiring
O(P log P + M log P) catalogue/Basic-module matching comparisons plus field-byte
validation. The previously documented selection scans, owned freshness identity
reconstruction, canonical-path filesystem work and shared stdout budget remain
unchanged. The 16 MiB accepted-record limit remains a wire bound rather than a
peak-heap or JVM producer bound.

The added parallel-sync policy is a bounded pure version decision. It checks
version-input length before parsing, accepting at most 64 bytes, and has no
scheduler, task creation, Gradle invocation, I/O, Provider realization or new
production caller. Its public export introduces no additional identity capture,
model decode or UI render call. No source-backed new responsiveness or memory
regression is established by this ordinary dependency merge.

Previous default-feature 30-test/library/formatting receipts belong to the
previous reviewed P2 source; those P2 bytes are preserved. This reviewer ran no
Cargo, rustc, JVM, Gradle, SDK, application or native command and changed only
these two external review files. Combined-source all-feature, Clippy, UI, real
SDK/late-configuration, full-app, native and lead CI gates remain pending. No
startup, hardware-rendering, peak-memory, cancellation timing, improvement or
large-project runtime performance claim is made. Original-test parity receives
zero new credit. This addendum introduces no product fix round.

The companion JSON binds the current source snapshot, previous review, dependency
merge receipt and reviewed source files by SHA-256. Older reviews are preserved.
